name: parspec-design
description: Parspec brand stack — composable Claude Code skills that compile a single brand SSoT (design-model.yaml) into Parspec-branded slides, ICP-credible craft rules, and per-surface generation. Built for Construction Materials Distributors.

plugins.name: parspec-design
plugins.description: Brand SSoT skill. Maintains Parspec design-model.yaml (colors, typography, motion, voice) and generates bundled previews. Versioned via YAML frontmatter and git tags so brand evolution is mechanical, not manual.

plugins.name: parspec-slides
plugins.description: Slide generation skill. Reads design-model.yaml from parspec-design and emits zero-dependency HTML decks with Parspec brand applied. Forked from zarazhangrui/frontend-slides — preserves viewport invariants, density limits, PPT/PDF/Vercel pipeline.

plugins.name: parspec-craft
plugins.description: Craft rules skill. Universal anti-AI-slop, color, typography rules + data-driven palette enforcement that reads avoid/primary_axis_preserved/typography from design-model.yaml. Lints any HTML against active brand version.

plugins.name: parspec-review
plugins.description: Design jury skill. 4 parallel vision-capable critic agents (composition / data-viz / brand-fidelity / anti-AI-slop) + a severity-times-agreement aggregator that replaces parspec-slides Round 5b single-reviewer pass. Catches compositional, data-viz, brand-fidelity, and template-feel issues that a single Opus pass misses. Anti-slop juror deliberately receives PNG only (no manifest priming) per ChatEval persona-diversity research.

plugins.name: parspec-pptx
plugins.description: PowerPoint .pptx generation skill. Reads design-model.yaml from parspec-design and emits editable .pptx via python-pptx. House register builds on local company deck templates so slides paste into company decks (profiles: master — Sept-2026 master deck format, default; townhall) with numbered cards, panel rows, problem-to-solution rows, umber funnels, chevrons, KPI tiles and CAD brackets. brand_artifacts register for standalone board memos (12 layouts). Headless LibreOffice render loop; PowerPoint daemon optional.
